raw.query: WITH current_dims AS (SELECT run_id FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current AND superseded_by IS NULL), latency AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.run_id FROM provenance.v_pool_latency AS p JOIN current_dims AS d USING (run_id) WHERE p.is_current), checks AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_enabled) AS enabled FROM provenance.check_definition) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM current_dims) AS effective_current_runs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latency) AS runs_with_pool_latency, checks.total AS defined_checks, checks.enabled AS enabled_checks FROM checks
